GotOpponent.description: Return 1 when script-creature pointer and its opponent reference at +0xe4 are nonzero, otherwise 0. The reference itself is not dereferenced or checked for a live target. A fixture with an unmapped nonzero pointer confirms that only presence is tested.

OpponentRange.description: With a nonzero script-creature and opponent reference+0xe4, return the stored float at creature+0xe8. Otherwise return the largest finite positive float32, bits0x7f7fffff. This is a cached field read, not distance computation or validation of the referenced opponent.

OffScreenTimer.description: Initializer 0x4417d0 calls global named-character callback0x923904 when both operand pointer and callback are nonzero. If a reference is returned, it stores that reference's first pointer as the bound object. The reader prefers this bound object; if null, it follows creature+0xd0 then reference+0 to the current world object. Failed/null links return zero. A failed named binding therefore falls back to self. A valid object returns its float at +0xf10. Initialization binds a raw object pointer; lifetime and rebinding are external.
OffScreenTimer.qualification: No shipped OffScreenTimer occurrence supplies a quoted initializer operand. Synthetic named cases validate callback/binding rules, not the engine alias resolver. Timer accumulation and units are not established here.

FreePlay.description: Read global0x93b2a4 as a signed 32-bit integer using x87 FILD. It is not normalized to a boolean. The native SCP evaluator stores the returned extended value to float32; the portable API exposes that storage boundary. Fixtures include negative values, 0/1/2, int32 extremes and rounding around2^24.

NumInSetAlive.description: Initializer accepts case-insensitive whole-token myset as sentinel-1. Otherwise parse an optional minus and a decimal integer prefix with unchecked 32-bit wrap; only resulting values1..16 survive, and all others become0. The condition replaces sentinel-1 with unsigned packet byte+0xb0. Selector0 returns0 without reading the count region. Otherwise return the unsigned byte at0x876847+selector as a float. Literal selectors1..16 and every byte value were verified; myset was verified across all256 packet-byte indices.
NumInSetAlive.qualification: The unchecked myset index is native behavior, not evidence that the actual global count-table allocation has256 elements. The source uses an explicit byte-index read adapter instead of inventing storage layout or update logic.

AlwaysTrue.description: Initializer defaults to float1 for null or empty input. A nonempty input is parsed by native decimal-prefix helper0x4f28e0. The result's raw float bits are returned in EAX, stored in the condition initializer slot, then the condition reader interprets argument five as a float. The name does not make this reader unconditionally return1. All236 authored occurrences have no quoted initializer operand.

adapters.scope: Named-character callback in OffScreenTimer initializer maps fixture names to actor references; runtime alias resolution and reference lifetime remain external.

portable.status: Core library and comparison harness compile with installed C#5 compiler. Managed execution/differential comparison remains pending.
adapters: ConditionCreature is an explicit projection of script-creature reference/range fields; host maintains their values and lifetime.
ConditionActorReference/ConditionObject project the weak-reference chain and off-screen timer field. Named resolution remains a host callback.
ConditionWorld.FreePlayValue and ReadAliveCount supply original global inputs without inventing population/update logic or count-table allocation size.
ScriptPacket.SetId projects byte+0xb0 and is populated separately by the host.
General SCP expression/variable binding and malformed source parsing remain outside these six reader bodies.
hostGuards: NumInSetAlive rejects direct selector values outside initializer output0..16/-1; myset still allows any packet byte through its read adapter.
Required world/count adapters fail explicitly when absent instead of dereferencing unavailable memory.
Initializer text accepts non-NUL ASCII; extended-byte case folding and signaling NaN payload behavior are outside this source domain.

remaining: World global updates, reference lifetime, range computation, off-screen timer accumulation and alive-count population are external input contracts, not recovered by these readers.

Literal NumInSetAlive initializer admits 1..16 or myset; myset reads an unchecked byte index. Fixtures use a synthetic 256-byte backing region and do not assert the actual global count-table allocation size.
All scalar reader checks compare values at the float32 storage boundary used by the native SCP evaluator; signaling NaN payload behavior is excluded.
Eight symbolic comparison RHS occurrences and one malformed gotoUpdate occurrence retain separate source/loader gaps; their condition bodies were still exercised.
